# Pull request

## Summary

What changes, in one or two sentences.

## Why

The problem this solves, or the constraint it respects.

## How to test

Steps to reproduce the behaviour and confirm the fix, plus any asset or disk needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes, and `pnpm test:e2e` too when UI or boot paths change
- [ ] No VM disk, proprietary media, release binary or secret committed
- [ ] Contributions are offered under the LumiBoot Source-Available License, see `LICENSE`
